PDFA-1B.xml.creator: veraPDF Consortium

PDFA-2B.xml.name: PDF/A-2b validation profile
PDFA-2B.xml.description: Validation rules against ISO 19005-2:2011, Level B
PDFA-2B.xml.creator: veraPDF Consortium

PDFA-3B.xml.name: PDF/A-3b validation profile
PDFA-3B.xml.description: Validation rules against ISO 19005-3:2012, Level B
PDFA-3B.xml.creator: veraPDF Consortium

ISO_19005_1:6.1.2-1.description: The % character of the file header shall occur at byte offset 0 of the file. The first line of a PDF file is a header identifying the version of the PDF specification to which the file conforms
ISO_19005_1:6.1.2-1.error: File header %1 (offset = %2) starts at non-zero offset or does not match the pattern %PDF-n.m

ISO_19005_1:6.1.2-2.description: The file header line shall be immediately followed by a comment consisting of a % character followed by at least four characters, each of whose encoded byte values shall have a decimal value greater than 127
ISO_19005_1:6.1.2-2.error: Binary comment in the file header is missing or does not start with 4 bytes with byte values above 127 (first four bytes = %1, %2, %3, %4)

ISO_19005_1:6.1.3-1.description: The file trailer dictionary shall contain the ID keyword. The file trailer referred to is either the last trailer dictionary in a PDF file, as described in PDF Reference 3.4.4 and 3.4.5, or the first page trailer in a linearized PDF file, as described in PDF Reference F.2
ISO_19005_1:6.1.3-1.error: Missing ID in the document trailer

ISO_19005_1:6.1.3-2.description: The keyword Encrypt shall not be used in the trailer dictionary
ISO_19005_1:6.1.3-2.error: Encrypt keyword is present in the trailer dictionary

ISO_19005_1:6.1.3-3.description: No data shall follow the last end-of-file marker except a single optional end-of-line marker
ISO_19005_1:6.1.3-3.error: %1 byte(s) of data is present after the last end-of-file marker

ISO_19005_1:6.1.3-4.description: In a linearized PDF, if the ID keyword is present in both the first page trailer dictionary and the last trailer dictionary, the value to both instances of the ID keyword shall be identical
ISO_19005_1:6.1.3-4.error: Last ID (%1) is present in the Linearized PDF and does not match the first page ID (%2)

ISO_19005_1:6.1.4-1.description: In a cross reference subsection header the starting object number and the range shall be separated by a single SPACE character (20h)
ISO_19005_1:6.1.4-1.error: Extra or missing spacings around in a subsection header of the cross reference table

ISO_19005_1:6.1.4-2.description: The xref keyword and the cross reference subsection header shall be separated by a single EOL marker
ISO_19005_1:6.1.4-2.error: Extra spacings or missing EOL characters after the 'xref' keyword in the cross reference table

ISO_19005_1:6.1.4-3.description: Xref streams shall not be used

ISO_19005_1:6.1.6-1.description: Hexadecimal strings shall contain an even number of non-white-space characters
ISO_19005_1:6.1.6-1.error: A hexadecimal string contains odd number (%1) of non-white-space characters

ISO_19005_1:6.1.6-2.description: All non-white-space characters in hexadecimal strings shall be in the range 0 to 9, A to F or a to f
ISO_19005_1:6.1.6-2.error: Hexadecimal string contains non-white-space characters outside the range 0 to 9, A to F or a to f

ISO_19005_1:6.1.7-1.description: The value of the Length key specified in the stream dictionary shall match the number of bytes in the file following the LINE FEED character after the stream keyword and preceding the EOL marker before the endstream keyword
ISO_19005_1:6.1.7-1.error: Actual length of the stream (%1 byte(s)) does not match the value of the Length key in the Stream dictionary (%2 byte(s))

ISO_19005_1:6.1.7-2.description: The stream keyword shall be followed either by a CARRIAGE RETURN (0Dh) and LINE FEED (0Ah) character sequence or by a single LINE FEED character. The endstream keyword shall be preceded by an EOL marker
ISO_19005_1:6.1.7-2.error: Extra spacings or missing EOL characters around keywords 'stream' and 'endstream'

ISO_19005_1:6.1.7-3.description: A stream object dictionary shall not contain the F, FFilter, or FDecodeParms keys
ISO_19005_1:6.1.7-3.test: F == null && FFilter == null && FDecodeParms == null
ISO_19005_1:6.1.7-3.error: A stream object dictionary contains %1 key(s)

ISO_19005_1:6.1.8-1.description: The object number and generation number shall be separated by a single white-space character. The generation number and obj keyword shall be separated by a single white-space character. The object number and endobj keyword shall each be preceded by an EOL marker. The obj and endobj keywords shall each be followed by an EOL marker
ISO_19005_1:6.1.8-1.error: Extra spacings or missing EOL characters around indirect object/generation number or keywords 'obj' and 'endobj'

ISO_19005_1:6.1.10-1.description: The LZWDecode filter shall not be permitted
ISO_19005_1:6.1.10-1.error: Unknown or not permitted Stream filter %1 is used

ISO_19005_1:6.1.10-2.description: The LZWDecode filter shall not be permitted
ISO_19005_1:6.1.10-2.error: LZW compression is used in the inline image

ISO_19005_1:6.1.11-1.description: A file specification dictionary, as defined in PDF 3.10.2, shall not contain the EF key
ISO_19005_1:6.1.11-1.error: A file specification dictionary contains the EF key

ISO_19005_1:6.1.11-2.description: A file's name dictionary, as defined in PDF Reference 3.6.3, shall not contain the EmbeddedFiles key
ISO_19005_1:6.1.11-2.error: The document contains embedded files (EmbeddedFiles key is present in the file's name dictionary)

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-1.description: Largest Integer value is 2,147,483,647. Smallest integer value is -2,147,483,648

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-2.description: Absolute real value must be less than or equal to 32767.0

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-3.description: Maximum length of a string (in bytes) is 65535

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-4.description: Maximum length of a name (in bytes) is 127

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-5.description: Maximum capacity of an array (in elements) is 8191

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-6.description: Maximum capacity of a dictionary (in entries) is 4095

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-7.description: Maximum number of indirect objects in a PDF file is 8,388,607
ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-7.error: Number of indirect objects in a PDF file (%1) exceeded 8,388,607

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-8.description: Maximum depth of graphics state nesting by q and Q operators is 28
ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-8.error: Depth of graphics state nesting of q/Q operators (%1) exceeded 28

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-9.description: Maximum number of DeviceN components is 8

ISO_19005_1:6.1.12-10.description: Maximum value of a CID (character identifier) is 65,535

ISO_19005_1:6.1.13-1.description: The document catalog dictionary shall not contain a key with the name OCProperties
ISO_19005_1:6.1.13-1.error: The document catalog dictionary contains the OCProperties entry

ISO_19005_1:6.2.2-1.description: A PDF/A-1 OutputIntent is an OutputIntent dictionary, as defined by PDF Reference 9.10.4, that is included in the file's OutputIntents array and has GTS_PDFA1 as the value of its S key and a valid ICC profile stream as the value its DestOutputProfile key
ISO_19005_1:6.2.2-1.error: The embedded PDF/A Output Intent colour profile is either invalid or does not provide BToA information

ISO_19005_1:6.2.2-2.description: If a file's OutputIntents array contains more than one entry, then all entries that contain a DestOutputProfile key shall have as the value of that key the same indirect object, which shall be a valid ICC profile stream
ISO_19005_1:6.2.2-2.error: File's OutputIntents array contains output intent dictionaries with non-matching destination output profiles (indirect keys %1)

ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.2-1.description: All ICCBased colour spaces shall be embedded as ICC profile streams as described in PDF Reference 4.5
ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.2-1.test: (deviceClass == "prtr" || deviceClass == "mntr" || deviceClass == "scnr" || deviceClass == "spac") && (colorSpace == "RGB " || colorSpace == "CMYK" || colorSpace == "GRAY" || colorSpace == "Lab ") && version < 3.0
ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.2-1.error: The embedded ICC profile (Device Class = %1, color space = %2, version = %3) is either invalid or does not satisfy PDF 1.4 requirements

ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.2-2.description: All ICCBased colour spaces shall be embedded as ICC profile streams as described in PDF Reference 4.5. The number of color components in the color space described by the ICC profile data must match the number of components actually in the ICC profile. As of PDF 1.4, N must be 1, 3, or 4
ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.2-2.error: The N entry (value %1) in the ICC profile dictionary is missing or does not match the number of components in the embedded ICC profile (color space %2)

ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.3-1.description: DeviceRGB may be used only if the file has a PDF/A-1 OutputIntent that uses an RGB colour space
ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.3-1.error: DeviceRGB colour space is used without RGB output intent profile

ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.3-2.description: DeviceCMYK may be used only if the file has a PDF/A-1 OutputIntent that uses a CMYK colour space
ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.3-2.error: DeviceCMYK colour space is used without CMYK output intent profile

ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.3-3.description: If an uncalibrated colour space is used in a file then that file shall contain a PDF/A-1 OutputIntent, as defined in 6.2.2
ISO_19005_1:6.2.3.3-3.error: DeviceGray colour space is used without output intent profile

ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-1.description: An Image dictionary shall not contain the Alternates key
ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-1.error: Alternates key is present in the Image dictionary

ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-2.description: An XObject dictionary (Image or Form) shall not contain the OPI key
ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-2.error: OPI key is present in the XObject dictionary

ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-3.description: If an Image dictionary contains the Interpolate key, its value shall be false
ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-3.error: The value of the Interpolate key in the Image dictionary is true

ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-4.description: If an Image dictionary contains the BitsPerComponent key, its value shall be 1, 2, 4 or 8
ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-4.test: isMask == true || BitsPerComponent == null || BitsPerComponent == 1 || BitsPerComponent == 2 || BitsPerComponent == 4 || BitsPerComponent == 8
ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-4.error: The value of the BitsPerComponent key in the Image dictionary is %1

ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-5.description: If an image mask dictionary contains the BitsPerComponent key, its value shall be 1
ISO_19005_1:6.2.4-5.error: The value of the BitsPerComponent key in the image mask dictionary is %1

ISO_19005_1:6.2.5-1.description: A form XObject dictionary shall not contain the Subtype2 key with a value of PS or the PS key
ISO_19005_1:6.2.5-1.error: The form XObject dictionary contains a PS key or Subtype2 key with value PS

ISO_19005_1:6.2.6-1.description: A conforming file shall not contain any reference XObjects
ISO_19005_1:6.2.6-1.error: The document contains a reference XObject (Ref key in the form XObject dictionary)

ISO_19005_1:6.2.7-1.description: A conforming file shall not contain any PostScript XObjects
ISO_19005_1:6.2.7-1.error: The document contains a PostScript XObject

ISO_19005_1:6.2.8-1.description: An ExtGState dictionary shall not contain the TR key
ISO_19005_1:6.2.8-1.error: An ExtGState dictionary contains the TR key

ISO_19005_1:6.2.8-2.description: An ExtGState dictionary shall not contain the TR2 key with a value other than Default
ISO_19005_1:6.2.8-2.error: An ExtGState dictionary contains the TR2 key with a value other than Default

ISO_19005_1:6.2.9-1.description: Where a rendering intent is specified, its value shall be one of the four values defined in PDF Reference RelativeColorimetric, AbsoluteColorimetric, Perceptual or Saturation
ISO_19005_1:6.2.9-1.error: A rendering intent with non-standard value %1 is used

ISO_19005_1:6.2.10-1.description: A content stream shall not contain any operators not defined in PDF Reference even if such operators are bracketed by the BX/EX compatibility operators
ISO_19005_1:6.2.10-1.error: A content stream contains operator %1 not defined in PDF Reference

ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-1.description: All fonts used in a conforming file shall conform to the font specifications defined in PDF Reference 5.5. Type - name - (Required) The type of PDF object that this dictionary describes; must be Font for a font dictionary
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-1.error: A Font dictionary has value %1 of Type entry instead of Font

ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-2.description: All fonts used in a conforming file shall conform to the font specifications defined in PDF Reference 5.5. Subtype - name - (Required) The type of font; must be "Type1" for Type 1 fonts, "MMType1" for multiple master fonts, "TrueType" for TrueType fonts "Type3" for Type 3 fonts, "Type0" for Type 0 fonts and "CIDFontType0" or "CIDFontType2" for CID fonts
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-2.test: Subtype == "Type1" || Subtype == "MMType1" || Subtype == "TrueType" || Subtype == "Type3" || Subtype == "Type0" || Subtype == "CIDFontType0" || Subtype == "CIDFontType2"
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-2.error: Invalid Subtype entry in font dictionary with value %1

ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-3.description: All fonts used in a conforming file shall conform to the font specifications defined in PDF Reference 5.5. BaseFont - name - (Required) The PostScript name of the font
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-3.error: A BaseFont entry is missing or has invalid type

ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-4.description: All fonts used in a conforming file shall conform to the font specifications defined in PDF Reference 5.5. FirstChar - integer - (Required except for the standard 14 fonts) The first character code defined in the font's Widths array
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-4.error: A non-standard simple font dictionary has missing or invalid FirstChar entry

ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-5.description: All fonts used in a conforming file shall conform to the font specifications defined in PDF Reference 5.5. LastChar - integer - (Required except for the standard 14 fonts) The last character code defined in the font's Widths array
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-5.error: A non-standard simple font dictionary has missing or invalid LastChar entry

ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-6.description: All fonts used in a conforming file shall conform to the font specifications defined in PDF Reference 5.5. Widths - array - (Required except for the standard 14 fonts; indirect reference preferred) An array of (LastChar − FirstChar + 1) widths
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-6.test: isStandard == true || (Widths_size != null && Widths_size == LastChar - FirstChar + 1)
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-6.error: Widths array is missing or has invalid size %1 instead of %2

ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-7.description: All fonts used in a conforming file shall conform to the font specifications defined in PDF Reference 5.5. The subtype is the value of the Subtype key, if present, in the font file stream dictionary. The only valid values of this key in PDF 1.4 are Type1C - Type 1–equivalent font program represented in the Compact Font Format (CFF) and CIDFontType0C - Type 0 CIDFont program represented in the Compact Font Format (CFF)
ISO_19005_1:6.3.2-7.error: Unsupported font file format %1 of the embedded font

ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.1-1.description: For any given composite (Type 0) font referenced within a conforming file, the CIDSystemInfo entries of its CIDFont and CMap dictionaries shall be compatible. In other words, the Registry and Ordering strings of the CIDSystemInfo dictionaries for that font shall be identical, unless the value of the Encoding key in the font dictionary is Identity-H or Identity-V
ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.1-1.test: cmapName == "Identity-H" || cmapName == "Identity-V" || (CIDFontOrdering != null && CIDFontOrdering == CMapOrdering && CIDFontRegistry != null && CIDFontRegistry == CMapRegistry)
ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.1-1.error: Registry and Ordering entries in the CIDFont and CMap dictionaries of a Type 0 font are not compatible (CIDSystemInfo Ordering = %1, CMap Ordering = %2, CIDSystemInfo Registry = %3, CMap Registry = %4)

ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.2-1.description: For all Type 2 CIDFonts that are used for rendering, the CIDFont dictionary shall contain a CIDToGIDMap entry that shall be a stream mapping from CIDs to glyph indices or the name Identity, as described in PDF Reference Table 5.13
ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.2-1.error: A Type 2 CIDFont dictionary has missing or invalid CIDToGIDMap entry

ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.3-1.description: All CMaps used within a conforming file, except Identity-H and Identity-V, shall be embedded in that file as described in PDF Reference 5.6.4
ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.3-1.error: A CMap is different from "Identity-H" or "Identity-V" and is not embedded

ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.3-2.description: For those CMaps that are embedded, the integer value of the WMode entry in the CMap dictionary shall be identical to the WMode value in the embedded CMap stream
ISO_19005_1:6.3.3.3-2.error: WMode entry (value %1) in the embedded CMap and in the CMap dictionary (value %2) are not identical

ISO_19005_1:6.3.4-1.description: The font programs for all fonts used within a conforming file shall be embedded within that file, as defined in PDF Reference 5.8, except when the fonts are used exclusively with text rendering mode 3
ISO_19005_1:6.3.4-1.error: The font program is not embedded

ISO_19005_1:6.3.5-1.description: Embedded font programs shall define all font glyphs referenced for rendering with conforming file
ISO_19005_1:6.3.5-1.error: Not all glyphs referenced for rendering are present in the embedded font program

ISO_19005_1:6.3.5-2.description: For all Type 1 font subsets referenced within a conforming file, the font descriptor dictionary shall include a CharSet string listing the character names defined in the font subset, as described in PDF Reference Table 5.18
ISO_19005_1:6.3.5-2.error: A Type1 font subset does not define CharSet entry in its Descriptor dictionary

ISO_19005_1:6.3.5-3.description: For all CIDFont subsets referenced within a conforming file, the font descriptor dictionary shall include a CIDSet stream identifying which CIDs are present in the embedded CIDFont file, as described in PDF Reference Table 5.20
ISO_19005_1:6.3.5-3.error: A CIDSet entry in the Font descriptor is missing or does not correctly identify all glyphs present in the embedded font subset and used for rendering

ISO_19005_1:6.3.6-1.description: For every font embedded in a conforming file and used for rendering, the glyph width information in the font dictionary and in the embedded font program shall be consistent
ISO_19005_1:6.3.6-1.test: renderingMode == 3 || widthFromFontProgram == null || widthFromDictionary == null || Math.abs(widthFromFontProgram - widthFromDictionary) <= 1
ISO_19005_1:6.3.6-1.error: Glyph width %1 in the embedded font program is not consistent with the Widths entry of the font dictionary (value %2)

ISO_19005_1:6.3.7-1.description: All non-symbolic TrueType fonts shall specify MacRomanEncoding or WinAnsiEncoding, either as the value of the Encoding entry in the font dictionary or as the value of the BaseEncoding entry in the dictionary that is the value of the Encoding entry in the font dictionary. If the value of the Encoding entry is a dictionary, it shall not contain a Differences entry
ISO_19005_1:6.3.7-1.error: A non-symbolic TrueType font encoding does not define a correct mapping to the Adobe Glyph List (Encoding = %1, Encoding entry contains a Differences = %2)

ISO_19005_1:6.3.7-2.description: All symbolic TrueType fonts shall not specify an Encoding entry in the font dictionary
ISO_19005_1:6.3.7-2.error: A symbolic TrueType font specifies an Encoding entry in its dictionary

ISO_19005_1:6.3.7-3.description: Font programs' "cmap" tables for all symbolic TrueType fonts shall contain exactly one encoding
ISO_19005_1:6.3.7-3.error: The embedded font program for a symbolic TrueType font contains %1 cmap subtables

ISO_19005_1:6.4-1.description: If an SMask key appears in an ExtGState dictionary, its value shall be None
ISO_19005_1:6.4-1.error: An ExtGState contains SMask key with a value other than None

ISO_19005_1:6.4-2.description: An XObject dictionary shall not contain the SMask key
ISO_19005_1:6.4-2.error: An XObject contains an SMask key

ISO_19005_1:6.4-3.description: A Group object with an S key with a value of Transparency shall not be included in a form XObject. A Group object with an S key with a value of Transparency shall not be included in a page dictionary
ISO_19005_1:6.4-3.error: A transparency group is present in a form XObject or page dictionary

ISO_19005_1:6.4-4.description: If a BM key is present in an ExtGState object, its value shall be Normal or Compatible
ISO_19005_1:6.4-4.error: An ExtGState dictionary contains the BM key (blend mode) with value %1 that is neither Normal or Compatible

ISO_19005_1:6.4-5.description: If a CA key is present in an ExtGState object, its value shall be 1.0
ISO_19005_1:6.4-5.error: An ExtGState dictionary contains the CA key (stroke alpha) with value %1 other than 1.0

ISO_19005_1:6.4-6.description: If a ca key is present in an ExtGState object, its value shall be 1.0
ISO_19005_1:6.4-6.error: An ExtGState dictionary contains the ca key (fill alpha) with value %1 other than 1.0

ISO_19005_1:6.5.2-1.description: Annotation types not defined in PDF Reference shall not be permitted. Additionally, the FileAttachment, Sound and Movie types shall not be permitted
ISO_19005_1:6.5.2-1.test: Subtype == "Text" || Subtype == "Link" || Subtype == "FreeText" || Subtype == "Line" || Subtype == "Square" || Subtype == "Circle" || Subtype == "Highlight" || Subtype == "Underline" || Subtype == "Squiggly" || Subtype == "StrikeOut" || Subtype == "Stamp" || Subtype == "Ink" || Subtype == "Popup" || Subtype == "Widget" || Subtype == "PrinterMark" || Subtype == "TrapNet"
ISO_19005_1:6.5.2-1.error: Unknown or not permitted Annotation type %1

ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-1.description: An annotation dictionary shall not contain the CA key with a value other than 1.0
ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-1.error: An annotation dictionary contains the CA key with value %1 instead of 1.0

ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-2.description: An annotation dictionary shall contain the F key. The F key’s Print flag bit shall be set to 1 and its Hidden, Invisible and NoView flag bits shall be set to 0
ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-2.error: Annotation flags are either missing or set the annotation to be hidden/invisible or non-printable (F = %1, Print = %2, Hidden = %3, Invisible = %4, NoView = %5)

ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-3.description: An annotation dictionary shall not contain the C array or the IC array unless the colour space of the DestOutputProfile in the PDF/A-1 OutputIntent dictionary, defined in 6.2.2, is RGB
ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-3.error: Annotation's color (C present = %1) or interior color (IC present = %2) is used without specifying RGB-based destination output profile

ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-4.description: For all annotation dictionaries containing an AP key, the appearance dictionary that it defines as its value shall contain only the N key
ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-4.error: Annotation's appearance dictionary contains entries %1 other than N

ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-5.description: If an annotation dictionary's Subtype key has a value of Widget and its FT key has a value of Btn, the value of the N key shall be an appearance subdictionary
ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-5.error: An annotation dictionary's Subtype key has a value of Widget and its FT key has a value of Btn, but the value of the N key is %1 instead of appearance subdictionary

ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-6.description: If an annotation dictionary's Subtype key has value other than Widget, or if FT key associated with Widget annotation has value other than Btn, the value of the N key shall be an appearance stream
ISO_19005_1:6.5.3-6.error: An annotation dictionary's Subtype key has a value %1 and its FT key has a value %2, but the value of the N key is not an appearance stream

ISO_19005_1:6.6.1-1.description: The Launch, Sound, Movie, ResetForm, ImportData and JavaScript actions shall not be permitted. Additionally, the deprecated set-state and no-op actions shall not be permitted. The Hide action shall not be permitted (Corrigendum 2)
ISO_19005_1:6.6.1-1.test: S == "GoTo" || S == "GoToR" || S == "Thread" || S == "URI" || S == "Named" || S == "SubmitForm"
ISO_19005_1:6.6.1-1.error: Unknown or not permitted Action type %1

ISO_19005_1:6.6.1-2.description: Named actions other than NextPage, PrevPage, FirstPage, and LastPage shall not be permitted
ISO_19005_1:6.6.1-2.error: Unknown or not permitted named action %1

ISO_19005_1:6.6.1-3.description: Interactive form fields shall not perform actions of any type
ISO_19005_1:6.6.1-3.error: Interactive form field contains an action object ('A' key)

ISO_19005_1:6.6.2-1.description: A Widget annotation dictionary shall not include an AA entry for an additional-actions dictionary
ISO_19005_1:6.6.2-1.error: A Widget annotation contains an additional-actions dictionary (AA entry)

ISO_19005_1:6.6.2-2.description: A Field dictionary shall not include an AA entry for an additional-actions dictionary
ISO_19005_1:6.6.2-2.error: A Field dictionary contains an additional-actions dictionary (AA entry)

ISO_19005_1:6.6.2-3.description: The document catalog dictionary shall not include an AA entry for an additional-actions dictionary
ISO_19005_1:6.6.2-3.error: The document catalog dictionary contains an additional-actions dictionary (AA entry)

ISO_19005_1:6.7.2-1.description: The document catalog dictionary of a conforming file shall contain the Metadata key. The metadata stream dictionary shall contain entry Type with value /Metadata and entry Subtype with value /XML

ISO_19005_2:6.2.11.2-1.description: All fonts and font programs used in a conforming file, regardless of rendering mode usage, shall conform to the provisions in ISO 32000-1:2008, 9.6 and 9.7, as well as to the font specifications referenced by these provisions. ISO_19005_2:6.2.11.2-4.description: All fonts and font programs used in a conforming file, regardless of rendering mode usage, shall conform to the provisions in ISO 32000-1:2008, 9.6 and 9.7, as well as to the font specifications referenced by these provisions.
